# Aaroh Campus OS

> Unified institutional academic operating platform for K.R. Mangalam University.

Aaroh Campus OS is the centralized portal for academic management, student tracking, faculty workflows, and campus administration.

## Core Portals

- [Student Portal](/student): Coursework tracking, dynamic attendance monitoring, lecture timetables, and academic records.
- [Faculty Portal](/faculty): Roll call submission, batch attendance recording, course syllabi, and departmental circulars.
- [Admin Portal](/admin): Institutional user directory, role provisioning, master timetable scheduling, and campus controls.
- [Authentication](/login): Closed institutional authentication for pre-enrolled university accounts.

## Documentation and Resources

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Complete URL index of institutional routes.
- [Robots Policy](/robots.txt): Crawler and indexing directives.
